# TripRemix\n\nTripRemix is a browser-first visual itinerary tool. It turns a sequence of travel stops into a map, estimates directional distance and travel load, flags obvious routing problems, animates the journey, and creates a shareable/remixable URL.\n\n## Primary capability\n- Paste cities or stops separated by lines, commas or arrows.\n- Visualize the route on OpenStreetMap.\n- Get a simple route-sanity score and travel-load estimate.\n- Play the route as an animation.\n- Share or remix the trip.\n- Open independent booking partners through disclosed affiliate links.\n\n## Important limitations\nDistance, travel-time and transport-mode outputs are rough planning estimates, not live schedule, visa, safety, weather or booking advice. Confirm critical information with official sources and booking providers.\n\nCanonical product URL: https://tripremix.vercel.app/\n
